in_sanskrit.name: कामलकार
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has the god of love (Kama) as his lord. Or, The one who holds a lotus in his hand.

in_tamil.name: காமலகர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is engaged in the work of Kama (god of love).

in_marathi.name: Kamalakar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kamalakar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who creates lotus flowers. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is often depicted on a lotus flower.

in_bengali.name: Kamalakar
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kamalakar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who creates lotus flowers. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is often depicted on a lotus flower.
